row: Katherine Johnson (MFHT, MFHST) is an experienced massage therapist specialising in advanced Sports Massage, Remedial Massage and Clinical Massage for the treatment of muscular problems and injuries. In these videos Katherine shares exercises which can help to promote flexibility and mobility of muscles.
